# Timex Ceramic

> Luxury Architectural Surfaces, Vitrified Tiles & Large-Format Porcelain Slabs

Timex Ceramic is a premier manufacturer and exporter of luxury vitrified tiles, porcelain slabs, and architectural ceramic surfaces based in India. Engineered for high-traffic commercial spaces, boutique hotels, and luxury residential developments worldwide.

## Featured Architectural Collections & Products

- [Harlem Series](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/harlem-series): Brick surface (150mm X 450mm), Shiny finish.
- [Ascot](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/ascot): Brick surface (600mm x 200mm), Matt finish.
- [Timex Stone Luxe A1](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/stone-luxe-series-01): Stone Look surface (800x1600 mm), Polished finish.
- [Timex Stone Royal B2](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/stone-royal-series-02): Stone Look surface (600x1200 mm), Matte finish.
- [Timex Subway Luxe A1](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/subway-luxe-series-01): Subway Look surface (800x1600 mm), Matte finish.
- [Timex Subway Royal B2](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/subway-royal-series-02): Subway Look surface (600x1200 mm), Polished finish.

- [Timex Moroccan Royal B2](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/moroccan-royal-series-02): Moroccan Look surface (600x1200 mm), Matte finish.
- [Timex Octagonal Luxe A1](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/octagonal-luxe-series-01): Octagonal Look surface (800x1600 mm), Matte finish.
- [Timex Octagonal Royal B2](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/octagonal-royal-series-02): Octagonal Look surface (600x1200 mm), Polished finish.

- [Timex Wooden Royal B2](https://www.timexceramic.com/product/wooden-royal-series-02): Wooden Look surface (600x1200 mm), Matte finish.

## Core Collections & Categories

- [Brick Collection](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/brick): Timeless rustic and industrial brick wall tiles.
- [Stone Look](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/stone): Natural mineral veining and tactile quarry stone surfaces.
- [Wooden Planks](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/wooden): Natural hardwood textures in vitrified porcelain.
- [Mosaic Collection](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/mosaic): Precision architectural geometric and artisan mosaics.
- [Subway Tiles](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/subway): Classic beveled and contemporary flat subway formats.
- [Marble Slabs](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/marble): Opulent Italian Calacatta, Statuario, and Onyx replications.
- [Terrazzo Series](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/terrazzo): Artisanal composite aggregate and Venetian terrazzo.
- [Hexagon & Decors](https://www.timexceramic.com/collections/hexagon): Geometric statement decor wall and floor tiles.
- [Complete Product Catalog](https://www.timexceramic.com/products): Full searchable database with specifications and textures.

## Interactive Tools & Specifier Portals

- [AI 3D Room Visualiser](https://www.timexceramic.com/visualiser): Real-time 3D room preview for floors and walls across residential and commercial scenes.
- [Tile & Box Calculator](https://www.timexceramic.com/calculator): Calculate coverage area, required boxes, adhesive, and wastage factor.
- [Custom PDF Catalogue Maker](https://www.timexceramic.com/catalogue-maker): Generate custom branded PDF presentations for clients.
- [Architects & Specifiers Portal](https://www.timexceramic.com/architect-portal): Technical data sheets, BIM/CAD files, and project consultation.
- [Authorized Dealer Portal](https://www.timexceramic.com/dealer-portal): Distribution network, dealership application, and stockist resources.
- [Downloads & Technical Catalogs](https://www.timexceramic.com/downloads): Download master brochures, testing certifications, and laying guidelines.

## Journal & Architectural Insights

- [Design Journal](https://www.timexceramic.com/blogs): Architectural insights, tiling trends, laying patterns, and maintenance guides.
- [Case Studies & Projects](https://www.timexceramic.com/projects): Commercial developments, luxury apartments, and hospitality case studies.
